chain.label: Airplane entered an unexplained, progressively worsening uncontrolled descent culminating in a near-vertical, unrecovered dive
chain.trigger: the first officer requested a return to CNO...radar data showed the airplane descending through 23,000 feet at a rate of about 6,500 fpm...the rate then rapidly increased...to 10,000 fpm...the airplane's nose pitch 'straight down' until it impacted terrain

chain.label: Airplane impacted high desert terrain in a near-vertical attitude
chain.trigger: The airplane impacted high desert terrain (an elevation of 3,350 feet) about 3 miles southeast of Helendale

chain.label: Both pilots killed
chain.trigger: The captain and the first officer were killed, and the airplane was destroyed

caused_by.evidence: the coroner determined that the cause of death for the pilots was massive blunt force trauma
